name: Zurich
registryBasis: The City of Zürich publishes official cadastral-survey open data and the Canton of Zürich provides a machine-readable AV WFS. GetCapabilities and DescribeFeatureType confirm the `ms:liegenschaften_f` parcel layer with MultiSurface geometry and safe cadastral keys `nbident`, `nummer`, and `egris_egrid`; unstable system object IDs and unrelated fields were excluded. Exact-point, native EPSG:2056 and standard-axis EPSG:4326 bounded WFS queries returned no features, so parcel geometry at the ranked locator is not verified.
scopeLimits: City-specific source discovery only. No parcel geometry was retained. Citywide/countrywide completeness, title, survey accuracy, and runtime suitability are not asserted. No owner, address, account/tax identifier, credentials, or token values were requested or retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: The official WFS and parcel-layer schema are public and safe fields are known. Exact point, earlier small boxes, a native EPSG:2056 ±100 m box and a standard EPSG:4326 (latitude,longitude) ±100 m box all returned HTTP 200 empty FeatureCollections; no polygon was available to retain at the locator.
remainingUncertainty: The advertised WGS84 bounding box includes the ranked point; no native extent was included in the layer capabilities. Empty corrected-CRS responses indicate no intersecting parcel feature in the tested extent, but broader citywide completeness was not tested.
nextStep: If continuing discovery, inspect a nearby official map view for local coverage, then issue only a bounded geometry request with safe cadastral keys.
